engine.induction_and_feed: Naturally aspirated, single overhead-valve cylinder, muffler-pressure fuel feed

mass.status: manufacturer component masses sum directly; verify installed fittings separately

fuel.status: candidate is within broad manual range but differs from factory 15% nitro adjustment; freeze actual test fuel before calibration

manufacturer_compatible_propellers.observed_data_limit: recommended size and product geometry only; no matched FS-64V/APC 13x6 load curve

manufacturer_compatible_propellers.propeller_manufacturer_intended_use: larger 2T/4T glow engines and electric-conversion models
manufacturer_compatible_propellers.observed_configuration: O.S. qualitative Spacewalker II flight review reports FS-64V with 14x6; brand not identified in retrieved article
manufacturer_compatible_propellers.observed_data_limit: no measured RPM, torque, thrust, coefficient map or prop RPM limit

torque_power.candidate_curve: generated by calibration_report.py from current candidate profile
torque_power.external_proxy: AIAA tested O.S. FS-a56, 9.32 cm3, not FS-64V; source values are not imported as fit targets
torque_power.uncertainty_status: candidate sensitivity is not a confidence interval

throttle_response.status: broad engineering sensitivity sweep only; no accepted 4T lag or rise/fall time

combustion_dynamics.status: true 4T event cadence and independent intake/pumping/valve terms; no measured misfire/phase map

pitch_speed_at_rated_rpm_mph.meaning: geometric pitch speed only, not airspeed or thrust

fuel_consumption.aiaa_fs_a56_proxy_flow_fit: 0.34*x + 27.11 mg/s; R2=0.97; x is ESC demand in watts
fuel_consumption.evidence_scope: different 9.32 cm3 FS-a56 in hybrid setup, one-minute steady samples; not FS64 shaft or endurance map
fuel_consumption.candidate_curve: per-knot inferred delivered/burned/unburned flow in calibration_report.json

idle_stalling.status: no FS64 measured idle hold, stop boundary, restart or repeated mixture tests; Saito value is not transferred

temperature_cooling.status: logger/model search span only; two-stroke comparator is not a 4T estimate or a threshold

sound_vibration.status: orders are kinematic; no FS-64V tach-synchronized sound/vibration measurement

aircraft_dynamics.documented_aircraft_observation: O.S. Spacewalker II / FS-64V / NITRO-X Standard 15-18 / 14x6 reported qualitatively
aircraft_dynamics.status: no takeoff, climb, cruise, acceleration, engine-out or windmilling validation

configuration_provenance.exact_fuel_and_prop_configuration: documented candidate; physical test article still required
